description: The sIPD model is a three-level Bayesian individual participant data meta-analysis model adapted for educational trials, where pupils are nested within schools and schools within trials.
title: Simplified IPD meta-analysis model (sIPD) for educational trials with heterogeneous outcome scales

description: The framework bins student ability into L labeled intervals (Table 2, from Foundational to Elite mastery), prompts the LLM to answer as a student of a given ability level with the correct answer supplied, and trains it with an MSE loss on next-token option probabilities against interval-averaged MCM
title: Simulated-respondent framework

description: A laboratory research method in which participants watch a video-recorded group discussion performed by actors, so that all participants share the same prior knowledge and are exposed to the same group process.
title: Simulated video group discussion method for isolating cognitive activities in collaborative learning

description: A simulation framework that models mastery learning as a repeated problem-level decision cycle in which simulated learners select skills via predefined strategies, the system selects problems, performance is generated via AFM, and mastery is updated via BKT with a 95% mastery threshold.
title: Simulation-based framework for evaluating learner task-selection strategies and system constraints in mastery-based ITS

description: The research team developed a coding scheme for (1) behaviors (posture and gestures, facial expressions, and vocalics) and (2) regulation strategies including SRL codes (C.2.1–C.2.6) and SSRL codes (C.3.1–C.3.2), plus social climate and participation codes (C.3.3–C.3.6), adapted from prior literatur
title: Simulation video coding scheme for behaviors and SRL/SSRL strategies

description: The editorial's closing design recommendation for CSCL research: computer-supported collaborative learning opens a multi-dimensional shared world in an evolving, co-created context, where \"Knowledge, roles, space, and time are not simple givens whose characteristics can be assumed\".
title: Situated-interaction analysis of CSCL processes

description: An observation coding scheme adapted from prior work that integrates spatial pedagogy space types with team-teaching research.
title: Six-behaviour spatial pedagogy coding scheme for team teaching

description: The review developed six deductive categories for classifying feedback comparisons based on methodological design: \"1) human feedback versus a control or as an intervention only, 2) device feedback versus a control or as an intervention only, 3) human versus human feedback, 4) device versus device f
title: Six-category taxonomy of feedback comparisons in cardiac arrest simulation education

description: The review classifies the application domains of evaluated serious games into six categories: health & wellness, culture, professional learning & training, social, support, and education.
title: Six-category taxonomy of serious game application domains for evaluation studies

description: The article names and substantively describes a classification of verbal teaching in endoscopy derived through Grounded Theory analysis of a 53-page, 12000-word transcript of 33 recorded procedures.
title: Six-category taxonomy of verbal teaching methods in endoscopy

description: The review developed an inductive, iterative coding framework to classify knowledge claims about preparing teachers for diverse learners.
title: Six-code thematic framework for knowledge claims in ITE-diversity research

description: To handle heterogeneity across FSR measures, the authors inductively reviewed more than a dozen survey instruments and derived a categorical coding scheme.
title: Six-dimension taxonomy of faculty-student relationships extracted from over a dozen measures

description: The review proposes a six-dimensional framework for authentic assessment (AA) characteristics consisting of authenticity in assessment, cognitive challenges, assessment criteria, feedback, student agency and social collaboration.
title: Six-dimensional framework of authentic assessment characteristics

description: The article inductively derived a coding taxonomy: \"This resulted in the following six DF: reviewing directions and strategies, sharing and confirming information, brainstorming, empirical evaluation, clarification and elaboration, and submission and reflection.\" These map onto inquiry-based learnin
title: Six discourse functions mapped onto inquiry-based knowledge construction categories

description: The article organizes its survey around six approaches that \"hold great promise for evaluating educational environments\": using the open web and crowd sourcing, comparing decisions of adaptive environments with human experts, using simulated learners, washing out selection bias, examining learning c
title: Six emerging evaluation approaches for intelligent tutoring and adaptive learning environments

description: The review develops a six-category typology of how deeply EER articles integrate theory, classifying each of the 24 included articles along four dimensions: didactic considerations, implementation of a specific EER, theoretical foundation connected with didactic considerations, and empirical verific
title: Six patterns of theoretical integration in EER research

description: The article describes a reusable development sequence underpinned by PBPT principles: a team of clinicians, academics, and researchers developed the metric \"using an iterative six‐stage process, culminating in a Delphi panel meeting\".
title: Six-stage iterative metric development process

description: The review refines and updates Black and Wiliam's (1998a) original three broad categories into \"six mutually exclusive types base d on who or what primarily leads or takes ownership of the process\".
title: Six-type typology of formative assessment interventions based on process leadership
